Edit this color photo into a photoreal Magritte-like surreal photograph. CRITICAL continuity locks: keep the Volkswagen Type 2 bus in the EXACT same position, scale, orientation, three-quarter angle, hover height, and circular-hole piercing relationship as the reference — do NOT move, rotate, enlarge, shrink, or restage the vehicle. Keep the same camera height and framing. Photoreal fine-art photography only — NO illustration, NO comic, NO CGI cartoon look.

Replace the concrete walls with a monumental vertical WALL MADE OF REAL CLOUDS: dense sculpted cumulus that still reads as a flat architectural plane meeting at a right angle, with a PERFECT circular aperture cut through the cloud-mass — the bus must protrude through that cloud-hole exactly as it did through concrete (front hanging in open air, rear still inside the cloud wall). The courtyard floor becomes a soft continuous cloud deck / mist floor beneath the hovering bus. Beyond the cloud walls: authentic open sky and distant real atmospheric clouds under soft overcast daylight.

Relight the cream VW for open-sky conditions: cool skylight fill, soft diffuse shadows, faint sky-color bounce on body panels, natural specular on chrome and glass matching the cloudy sky — no studio look.

Integrate LARGE environmental typography formed in the cloud wall itself or as soft shadow-lettering across the cloud face (partially occluded by the bus), readable exact text: "GPT IMAGE 2.6" and "SUNBURST". No other slogans, no people.

The vertical plane must literally be clouds the bus is stuck in — not a cliff above clouds.
